taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station Maakoro-street, Bori Metropolis. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 168 | 1.71 | 1.71
2 | 484 | 7.45 | 9.16
3 | 255 | 15.3 | 24.4
4 | 1109 | 25 | 49.4
5 | 807 | 74.2 | 124
6 | 8895 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as KHKH-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station Maakoro-street, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

Site Report: Maakoro-street, Bori Metropolis.

The vertical electrical sounding (VES) results for this station indicate a six-layer subsurface sequence. The resistivity profile begins at 168 ohm-m in the first 1.71m, increasing to 484 ohm-m in the second layer. A decrease follows to 255 ohm-m in the third layer, before a sharp increase to 1109 ohm-m in the fourth layer. The fifth layer shows a decrease to 807 ohm-m, followed by a high-resistivity base layer of 8895 ohm-m.

The calculated curve-type sequence for these layers is KHKH. This matches the survey classification currently on file, confirming the interpreted geological transition between the identified layers.

{"curve_type_stated": "KHKH", "label_issue_flagged": false}
